title: Differentially Private Manifold Denoising
abstract: arXiv:2604.00942v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern data analysis increasingly relies on manifold-based methods that use local geometry to extract low-dimensional structure from noisy observations. Yet in domains such as biomedicine and public health, privacy regulations restrict access to individual-level data, while perturbations introduced to protect privacy can distort the geometric information needed for analysis. We introduce a manifold denoising framework that uses private reference data to correct noisy public queries, bringing differential privacy to local geometric estimation. Starting from a hard correction based on the estimated tangent space, we develop a noise-adaptive soft correction that avoids specifying the intrinsic dimension. Furthermore, we construct a shared Gaussian field that couples evaluations across locations and bandwidths with moderate marginal noise inflation. translated_abstract: 现代数据分析日益依赖于基于流形的方法，这类方法利用局部几何从含噪声的观测中提取低维结构。然而在生物医学和公共卫生等领域，隐私法规限制了对个体层面数据的访问，而为保护隐私所引入的扰动又可能扭曲分析所需的几何信息。我们提出了一种流形去噪框架，利用隐私参考数据来校正含噪声的公共查询，将差分隐私引入局部几何估计。从基于估计切空间的硬校正出发，我们进一步发展了一种噪声自适应的软校正方法，从而无需预先指定数据的内在维度。此外，我们构建了一个共享高斯场，将不同位置和带宽上的评估相互耦合，仅需适度的边际噪声放大。在流形正则性和采样密度的标准假设下，我们建立了非……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种差分隐私流形去噪框架，利用隐私参考数据校正含噪声的公共查询，通过噪声自适应软校正与共享高斯场，在无需指定内在维度的情况下实现隐私保护下的局部几何估计，并提供了理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a differentially private manifold denoising framework that uses private reference data to correct noisy public queries, employing noise-adaptive soft correction and a shared Gaussian field to enable privacy-preserving local geometric estimation without specifying the intrinsic dimension, supported by theoretical guarantees.
